additionalRules: A Riders of Eomer Army must include Eomer, who is always the Army's General.
Riders of Rohan do not count towards this Army's Bow Limit.

specialRules.name: Look to the sun
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any friendly Activation Phase, Gandalf can use this special rule so long as he is alive and on the battlefield. If he does, then until the end of the turn, enemy models Engaged in Combat with a friendly Cavalry model that made a Charge that turn, or Supporting a Combat against a friendly Cavalry model that made a Charge that turn, suffer a -1 penalty to their Duel Roll.

specialRules.name: "Ride for ruin and the world's ending"
specialRules.text: Friendly Rohan Cavalry models gain a bonus of +1 to their Strength on a turn in which they Charge.

specialRules.name: "To the King!"
specialRules.text: Eomer may declare a Heroic Combat each turn for free.

specialRules.name: Guthwine
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Additionally, each time a model armed with Gúthwinë rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, they may immediately make a single additional To Wound Roll against the same target. If this additional To Wound Roll is a natural 6, this will not benefit from this special rule.

specialRules.name: Glamdring
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Glamdring.

specialRules.name: Narya
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Gandalf may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

specialRules.name: Lord of the Mearas
specialRules.text: Whilst mounted upon Shadowfax, Gandalf rolls two dice and picks for the highest for Jump, Leap and Swim tests. Also, Shadowfax only halves his Move value in difficult terrain, rather than quartering it.

specialRules.name: Horn of the Hammerhand
specialRules.text: This is a Unique war horn. Additionally, once per game at the start of any Move Phase, Erkenbrand can unleash a fearsome blow of the Horn of the Hammerhand. Until the End Phase of the turn, enemy models within 24" of Erkenbrand suffer a -1 penalty to any Courage Test they are required to make.

units.name: Captain of Rohan
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If this model is within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, then it gains a bonus of +1 to its Fight Value in a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Spear Mastery
specialRules.text: This model may use its throwing spear as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it in either the preceding Move Phase or Shoot Phase.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub Riders of Eomer army-list page. Eomer, Captain of Rohan, and Rider of Rohan stat blocks from the Rohan faction page; Gandalf the White from the Gondor faction page; Erkenbrand, Captain of Rohan from the Good Legacy faction page.
